docs.summary: A Figma-like editor: the file bar, pages and layers, the canvas, and the full properties panel (Design, Prototype, Dev mode) drawn from the template’s JSON.
docs.narrow: Both panels start hidden and float over the canvas from their own edge when opened; Escape closes one. The bar’s tools wrap onto a second line.
try: Select the Sign in button: Design shows alignment, position and rotation, layout and resizing, appearance, fill, stroke, effects, its instance properties and export.
Change Rotation, Opacity, Corner radius or the fill’s colour: the canvas follows at once; Dev mode’s CSS follows too.
Turn on Individual corners, set Sides to Custom, add a fill and switch it to Linear gradient (GradientEditor), add an effect and change its type.
Select the Sign in frame: auto layout is vertical, so the alignment grid, gap and padding show; Layout guides and Selection colours appear (recolour every child at once).
Open Prototype: the button navigates to Home with Smart animate; Dev mode: measurements, CSS, colours and export.
notBuilt: Multiple selection, so Distribute says it isn’t part of the example.
Variables and styles on a value (NumberField can show a variable; none are bound here).
Auto layout re-arranging the canvas (the values are kept and shown in Dev mode’s CSS; the canvas keeps positions).
Gradients, images, effects and individual corners drawn on the canvas (the canvas draws the top solid fill, opacity, one radius, rotation and the first stroke).

docs.summary: The editor with the inspector on Prototype: flow starting point, interactions, scroll behaviour and prototype settings.
try: Select the Sign in button: its interaction navigates to Home with Smart animate; change the trigger or the animation.
Select the Sign in frame: it’s the flow’s starting point.

docs.summary: The prototype played full size, one frame at a time: the flow’s frames on one side, what can be pressed and where it leads on the other.
docs.narrow: Both panels start hidden and float over the stage when opened; the bar keeps Back, the frame and Previous, Next and Restart.
try: Press the Sign in button on the stage: the frame becomes Home in place, as Smart animate.
Press anything else: a note says it doesn’t lead anywhere.
Use Previous, Next and Restart, or pick a frame from Frames.

docs.summary: The editor in Dev mode: measurements, CSS generated from the layer’s values, its colours and export.
try: Select any layer: its CSS updates as you change it on the Design tab.

docs.summary: The editor in comment mode: the page’s threads in the properties panel, each pinned to a layer, with replies and resolve.
docs.narrow: As the editor: the comments panel floats over the canvas from its edge.
try: Choose “On Sign in button”: the layer is selected on the canvas and in the layers.
Write a reply and press Reply: it joins the thread at once.
Resolve a thread: it folds away; Show resolved brings the closed ones back.
